name: Channels: a fitting emoji for new channels
author: wizard
description: A new channel whose name has no emoji gets a fitting one from a small offline word list, stored at the start of its name (Money becomes 💰 Money, Podcast 🎙️ Podcast); a name that matches nothing keeps 💬. Your own emoji is never replaced, and you can change or remove it with the channel's emoji picker. Also when your agent creates a channel.
